topic: How would the 0.25 dB passband loss affect link budget margins in low-noise satellite receiver frontends?
response: A 0.25 dB passband loss in low-noise satellite receiver frontends would decrease link budget margins by reducing the effective gain, leading to a decrease in signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). This reduction can be calculated as a function of the passband loss and the system's noise temperature, resulting in a decrease in the maximum data rate that can be supported.
